evidence.claim: Fermat produce e vende rettificatrici cilindriche e relativi accessori, con assistenza dopo la vendita, nata dalla ZEVO di Praga rilevata nel 2008.
evidence.quote: It produces and sells cylindrical grinders and related accessories, with after-sales support. || Cylindrical grinding is the work of FERMAT Machine Tool, the member of the FERMAT Group that grew out of ZEVO Prague, acquired in 2008.
